retirement_rows.addressed_by: V626 emits one literal 12-row Markdown and YAML contract and checks closed fields, producer names, and full order independently.
V626 replaces the stale 13-row document and three-row YAML with the same 12 rows and uses the recognized aggregation substrate prefix.

V626 removes the invalid demand that primary pages supply an ARC execution oracle; it treats papers as source receipts, validates local GGUF cache metadata separately, and completes on an honest empty source delta.
retirement_rows.prior_verdict: blocked_primary_source_receipt: primary pages are source receipts only; no product, hardware, model, or ARC execution oracle was invoked.

retirement_rows.addressed_by: Exp7126 does not rerun generation; it reconstructs phase evidence and defines observable subprocess caps from existing receipts.
Exp7126 removes GPU readiness from the diagnostic scope and localizes the first absent start receipt without loading a model.
Exp7126 changes the deliverable from a value cell to offline phase forensics with a fixed receipt schema and no solve claim.
Exp7127 removes the preflight gate, selects one registry-eligible game inline, and directly runs the existing scored E3 entrypoint.
Exp7127 has no gated_on or requires chain and writes a terminal artifact before any model or GPU setup.
Exp7127 evaluates GPU and model liveness inline and bounds every subprocess instead of treating a reusable lease artifact as an upstream gate.
Exp7127 replaces the missing producer-field dependency with one self-contained paired cell and phase-level receipts.
Exp7127 uses hard setup and arm subprocess caps, persists every phase receipt, and treats a complete zero-level pair as terminal null.
Exp7128 has no readiness gate, accepts every terminal Exp7127 class, and audits raw receipts plus removable action inputs.
Exp7129 uses the proven local chat transport, bounds the bank to 12 base instances, removes the old entrance dependency, and writes raw rows after each invocation.
Exp7130 commits executable actions only after exact checking and measures retry or abstention outcomes rather than a self-commitment wording shortcut.
Exp7130 replaces signed latent interventions with observable exact penalties, cross-run uncertainty, and executed accept-retry-abstain decisions.
Exp7131 learns from current GGUF-generated actions, delays every write until later exact feedback, and measures future model behavior against equal-budget controls.
Exp7132 consumes a newly completed V626 memory artifact directly and tests explicit ordered writer-reader pairs without the retired route-memory activation chain.
Exp7132 replaces the missing activation bus with fixed-schema, source-hashed memory and a single producer field declared identically upstream.
Exp7132 uses memory admitted from current GGUF actions and measures all six directional transfers against no-memory, note, and source-regeneration controls.
Exp7134 uses an independently validated corrected Python proposal, matched energy-evaluation budgets, sealed finite laws, and makes no Rust or hardware claim.
